<thought>Now that I have the list of valid functional groups, I will search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that matches the intramolecular carbonyl‑ene reaction. The forward reaction breaks a ketone (functional group “ketones”) and an alkene (“C‑C double bonds”), forms an aliphatic alcohol (“aliphatic hydroxyls”), and creates a new C‑C bond while breaking C=O and C=C bonds. I will use these criteria and the target molecule SMILES (without atom mapping) to find the appropriate template.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=C(c1ccccc1)C1CCC[C]1(O)C(F)(F)F",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C double bonds"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C=O", "C=C"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C"]
}</action_input>
